label: For "Payment Routing Optimization": Route each payment to the acquirer or rail that maximises authorisation success at minimum fee, adapting to live outages and issuer behaviour. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Replay evaluation ignores routes never chosen.
